Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SPECIFICATION FOR 
TERMINALS FOR ELECTRONIC EQUIPMENT 

PART 2 DETAIL SPECiFtCATION FOR TERMINALS 

Section 7 Terminal, Non-Insulated, with Insulated Captive Spring 

Cap, TypeTSL 2 



1. Scope — This standard ( Part 2/Sec 7 ) covers detail requirements of terminals, non-insulated, with 
insulated captive spring cap, type TSL 2 and shall be read in conjunction with IS : 4007 ( Part 1 )-1982 
'Specification for terminals for electronic equipment: Part 1 General requirements and tests {first 
revision ) '. 



2. Climatic Test Severities

Damp heat ( steady state ) 
Damp heat ( cyclic ) 
Low air pressure

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is based on JSS 52710-Jan 1974 'Specification for terminals, captive screw 
cap andfcaptive spring loaded', published by Ministry of Defence. In addition to climatic severities 
specified in JSS-52710-Jan 1974, the climatic severities for commercial usage have been included in 
this standard.
